text: Manifest divine creativity. When starting a new project or any important matter, instead of inventing and planning what you want to do and when, enter a state of quiet, prayerful emptiness. Set aside your ego, your ambitions and the desire to make an impression. Imagine yourself as a hollow, clean vessel and mentally invite the Divine Flow to enter and create through you. And the beauty of the resulting creation will show how much you were able to push aside the “human” in yourself, freeing space for the divine.
